observations: Photo 0 shows the retail packaging for a Qasa Blender & Grinder.
The brand 'QASA' and model 'QBL-18L40' are clearly printed on the box.
The box features icons for 'Overheat Protection', 'Copper Big Motor', and '1 YEAR Warranty'.
The box depicts a blender jug and a smaller grinder mill attachment.
There is a watermark for 'EKSCO SOLAR' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.
The actual appliance is not visible; only the cardboard box is shown.

claims.evidence: The brand and product type are clearly printed on the box in photo 0.
The visible parts of the box do not explicitly state AC/DC or 12V operation.
The wattage or power consumption is not visible on the packaging shown.
While the watermark suggests a solar-focused seller, the box itself doesn't confirm solar compatibility.
This is a subjective performance claim that cannot be verified through photos.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different, used, or damaged item.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual blender and grinder out of the box.
risks.if_unproven: as a used and heavily worn unit

risks.risk: The motor may be burnt out or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the blender powered on and the blades spinning.

risks.risk: The grinder mill attachment shown on the box may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo showing all components (base, jug, and mill) together.
risks.if_unproven: as a blender only without the grinder

risks.risk: The item may be a standard AC unit rather than the claimed AC/DC solar-compatible version.
risks.proof: A photo of the technical specification label on the bottom of the motor base.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual blender and grinder outside of the box.
Photo of the technical specification label/rating plate on the bottom of the motor base.
Video of the unit plugged in and running.
Photo of all included accessories (jug and grinder mill).
response.reason: The model number is clearly identified from the packaging, allowing for a valuation based on its worst-case condition as a used, unverified unit.
